title: Quasi-coherent geometric realization of a graded action without finiteness assumptions
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $B=\bigoplus_{k\ge0}B_k$ a commutative graded $A$-algebra (the $B_k$ are $A$-submodules with $B_kB_l\subseteq B_{k+l}$ and $1\in B_0$, the structure map $A\to B$ landing in $B_0$). Let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and write $f^\sharp(a)\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ for the image of $a\in A$. Let $(\mathcal G_m)_{m\ge0}$ be quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], and for all $k,m\ge0$ and $b\in B_k$ let $\mu^{(m)}_b:\mathcal G_m\to\mathcal G_{m+k}$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-linear map [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], such that: (i) $\mu^{(m)}_{b+b'}=\mu^{(m)}_b+\mu^{(m)}_{b'}$ for $b,b'\in B_k$; (ii) $\mu^{(m+l)}_b\circ\mu^{(m)}_{b'}=\mu^{(m)}_{bb'}$ for $b\in B_k$, $b'\in B_l$; (iii) for $a\in A$ with image $a\cdot1\in B_0$, $\mu^{(m)}_{a\cdot1}$ is multiplication by $f^\sharp(a)$ on $\mathcal G_m$. Put $g=\operatorname{Spec}(A\to B)$, $Y=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}B$, $\pi:Y\to X$ and $f_B:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}B$. Then there exists a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module $F$ and maps $\iota_m:G_m\to\pi_*F$ exhibiting $\pi_*F$ as their coproduct in $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], with $\mu^{(m)}_b$ followed by $\iota_{m+k}$ equal to $\iota_m$ followed by the pushforward of multiplication by $f_B^\sharp(b)$ on $F$, for every $k,m$ and $b\in B_k$. There is no finite-type or finite-presentation conclusion.

proof.text: Form the sheaf coproduct of the G_m; it is quasi-coherent by coproduct closure. On an affine U = Spec C, the tilde equivalence and its preservation of coproducts identify its section module with the algebraic direct sum of G_m(U). For b = sum_k b_k and t = sum_m t_m define b t = sum_(k,m) mu^(m)_(b_k)(t_m). Both sums have finite support. The internal grading makes the b_k unique. Additivity gives additivity in b and t. The multiplication law identifies the (k,l,m) terms in b(b't) and (bb')t after reindexing. The scalar law with a = 1 gives 1t = t, and with general a gives the balancing relation between the A-actions. O_X-linearity of each mu makes the B-action commute with C. Thus the action extends to C tensor_A B.

On a basic open in U, quasi-coherence identifies the summands with their localized C-modules. Tensor localization commutes with coproducts by its left-adjoint universal property. Naturality of mu identifies each localized homogeneous action with the restricted action. Hence the C tensor_A B module structures commute with restriction. Refine the intersections of affine opens by basic affine opens; the restriction identities and the sheaf gluing axiom give a sheaf module over the pulled-back algebra. Its underlying O_X-module is the original quasi-coherent coproduct.

Relative-spec base change identifies the pulled-back algebra with pi_* O_Y and Y with its relative spectrum. Use the affine module correspondence for pi to realize the algebra module as pi_*F, with F quasi-coherent. Transport the homogeneous inclusions through this algebra-linear isomorphism. Restriction of scalars recovers the coproduct universal property. On each affine U the transported image of the m-th summand multiplied by fB^sharp(b) is exactly the transported image of mu m k b, by the defining action formula. Equality of sheaf maps is tested on this cover, giving the global compatibility equation.

theorem gradedModule_quasicoherent_realization
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (graded : ℕ → Submodule A B)
    (hgrading : DirectSum.IsInternal graded)
    (hunit : (1 : B) ∈ graded 0)
    (hmul : ∀ (k l : ℕ) {x y : B}, x ∈ graded k → y ∈ graded l → x * y ∈ graded (k + l))
    (hscalar : ∀ (a : A), algebraMap A B a ∈ graded 0)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (G : ℕ → SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (hG : ∀ m : ℕ, (G m).IsQuasicoherent)
    (mu : ∀ (m k : ℕ), graded k → (G m ⟶ G (m + k)))
    (hmu_add : ∀ (m k : ℕ) (b b' : graded k),
      mu m k (b + b') = mu m k b + mu m k b')
    (hmu_mul : ∀ (m k l : ℕ) (b : graded k) (b' : graded l),
      HEq (mu m l b' ≫ mu (m + l) k b)
        (mu m (k + l) ⟨b.val * b'.val, hmul k l b.property b'.property⟩))
    (hmu_scalar : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : A) (U : X.Opens)
      (t : (G m).val.obj (op U)),
      HEq ((mu m 0 ⟨algebraMap A B a, hscalar a⟩).val.app (op U) t)
        ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := U))).op).hom
          (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom a) • t))
    :
    let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
    let Y := pullback f g
    let pi : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f g
    let fB : Y ⟶ Spec (.of B) := pullback.snd f g
    ∃ (F : Y.Modules), F.IsQuasicoherent ∧
      ∃ (iota : ∀ m : ℕ, G m ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).obj F),
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).obj F) iota)) ∧
          ∀ (k m : ℕ) (b : graded k),
            mu m k b ≫ iota (m + k) = iota m ≫
              (Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).map
                (F.smulHom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫ fB.appTop).hom b.val))
